crossRefs.note: May Yahweh judge between me and you, and may Yahweh avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.
Thus Joash the king didn’t remember the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but killed his son. When he…
Hear, you peoples, all of you. Listen, O earth, and all that is therein: and let the Lord Yahweh be witness against…
Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
I will bear the indignation of Yahweh, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case, and executes…
David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul had certainly come.

translations.web: May Yahweh therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.”
translations.bsb: May the LORD be our judge and decide between you and me. May He take notice and plead my case and deliver me from your hand.”
translations.kjv: The LORD therefore be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thine hand.
translations.asv: Jehovah therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thy hand.
